selection: Four previously unfitted source regions from two already pinned local repositories; each has a disabled-capability and enabled-capability contract. Paired contracts and regions from the same repository must never be split across source folds.

paperless_contract.root: OriginalsOnlyStrategy/ArchiveOnlyStrategy/OriginalAndArchiveStrategy construction then add_document, with follow_formatting fixed at this boundary
paperless_contract.observations: Return/error and ordered ZIP entries including filenames and complete file contents. Compare logical archive records, not timestamp-dependent raw ZIP bytes.
paperless_contract.retained_capability: Export arbitrary valid document file payloads, original/archive choice and collision handling under the configured naming policy. No whitelist of document IDs or file contents.
paperless_contract.assumptions: Ordinary document interface, stable valid local files, terminating deterministic get_public_filename gateway; no reflection, dynamic strategy monkeypatching or external direct calls to the removed private method. Constructor option is a capability constraint, not inferred from observed requests.
paperless_contract.test_boundary: Run the entire frozen bulk_download.py module with real standard-library ZIP/file operations; document ORM interface is a declared test double. HTTP, permission resolution and ORM are outside this boundary.
paperless_contract.scenarios: Four document sets (empty, single, collision, original/archive fallback) times three strategies times ZIP_STORED/ZIP_DEFLATED; 24 pairs per contract

saleor_contract.root: Frozen _append_line_to_update function acting on a frozen CheckoutLineData dataclass and a plain line-state interface
saleor_contract.observations: Return/error, all quantity/override/reason/metadata state, ordered to_update identities including duplicates, and to_delete identities
saleor_contract.retained_capability: Quantity and metadata updates; enabled contracts also retain custom-price and reason updates. Disabled contracts require both custom_price_to_update and custom_price_reason_to_update to be False for every invocation, without restricting quantity/price values to the test sample.
saleor_contract.assumptions: Exact upstream dataclass with ordinary Boolean fields; no subclasses/property hooks/reflection or concurrent mutation. Line-state adapter exposes declared fields and the upstream metadata method.
saleor_contract.test_boundary: Compile exact upstream function/dataclass/metadata method ASTs with postponed annotations. Database model storage is represented by the explicit object/write-plan boundary; no transaction, trigger, permission or real database execution claim.
saleor_contract.scenarios: quantity_update in false/true, quantity in -1/0/3, replace/deleted/prequeued in false/true; disabled price flags both false, enabled flags each false/true. 48 disabled and 192 enabled pairs per region. Metadata payload alternates deterministically.

label_rule: Necessary label 1 requires an executed within-contract counterexample with successful original. Conditional removable label 0 requires a source-checked unreachable-region argument plus all sampled pairs agreeing. Passing samples alone => null. Labels apply only to explicit source boundaries; full_application_label remains null.
proof_rule: Paperless: deleted method's only syntactic reference is the nonselected constructor binding. Saleor: exact dataclass Boolean field is contractually False and deleted region is an if guarded solely by that field. Record assumptions and source hashes; these are bounded structural arguments, not whole-system equivalence proofs.
independence: Two third-party source repositories, four regions, eight contract records; not eight independent software systems. Selected by the same researcher after earlier results, not blind or independently adjudicated. All prior authored fixtures remain a separate provenance group.
scoring: Freeze all current model/extractor code and parameters. Do not hand-invent Boolean features for these sources, do not refit, and do not report probability metrics. Existing finite-fixture feature domain does not cover these source boundaries; scores abstain.
stop: One frozen eight-record batch, preserve unknowns/failures. No additional candidates to force balance, no application edits, no deployment/deletion authorization, no performance run.
